# CBS Sports

> CBS Sports delivers sports news, live scores, schedules, standings, stats, fantasy games, picks, and video across major pro and college leagues.

CBS Sports covers professional and collegiate sports with league hubs, game tracking, rankings, betting and picks content, fantasy products, and tournament games. The site emphasizes timely news, scores, schedules, standings, player information, and event-specific coverage for major U.S. and international sports.

## Core Sports Hubs
- [NFL](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/): NFL news, scores, schedules, standings, stats, injuries, and analysis.
- [NBA](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/): NBA news, live scores, standings, player updates, and game coverage.
- [MLB](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/): MLB news, scores, schedules, standings, stats, and roster updates.
- [NHL](https://www.cbssports.com/nhl/): NHL news, scores, standings, schedules, and hockey analysis.
- [College Football](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/): College football news, rankings, scores, schedules, and postseason coverage.
- [College Basketball](https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/): Men's college basketball news, scores, rankings, and tournament coverage.
- [Women's College Basketball](https://www.cbssports.com/womens-college-basketball/): Women's college basketball news, scores, rankings, and game coverage.
- [Soccer](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/): Soccer news, scores, standings, and coverage of major global competitions.

## Additional Sports
- [Golf](https://www.cbssports.com/golf/): Golf news, leaderboards, tournament coverage, and player updates.
- [UFC](https://www.cbssports.com/ufc/): UFC news, fight cards, results, rankings, and event analysis.
- [WWE](https://www.cbssports.com/wwe/): WWE news, event results, match coverage, and wrestling analysis.
- [Tennis](https://www.cbssports.com/tennis/): Tennis news, tournament coverage, results, and player updates.
- [WNBA](https://www.cbssports.com/wnba/): WNBA news, scores, standings, schedules, and player coverage.
- [NWSL](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/nwsl/): NWSL news, scores, standings, and women's club soccer coverage.
- [Champions League](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/champions-league/): UEFA Champions League news, scores, fixtures, and standings.
- [Europa League](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/europa-league/): UEFA Europa League news, scores, fixtures, and knockout coverage.

## Scores, Schedules, and Standings
- [Live Scores](https://www.cbssports.com/live/): Central hub for live scores, in-progress games, and current results.
- [NFL Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/schedule/): NFL game schedule with weekly matchups and kickoff times.
- [NBA Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/schedule/): NBA schedule with daily games and broadcast timing.
- [MLB Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/schedule/): MLB schedule with daily matchups and start times.
- [NHL Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/nhl/schedule/): NHL schedule with upcoming games and puck drop times.
- [College Football Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/schedule/): College football schedule with weekly slates and kickoff information.
- [College Basketball Schedule](https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/schedule/): Men's college basketball schedule with daily game listings.
- [NBA Standings](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/standings/): NBA conference standings, records, and playoff positioning.

## Rankings and Polls

- [NBA Power Rankings](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/powerrankings/): NBA team rankings with commentary on recent performance.
- [MLB Power Rankings](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/powerrankings/): MLB team rankings tracking form and league trends.
- [College Football Rankings](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/rankings/): College football rankings, polls, and playoff race context.
- [College Basketball Rankings](https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/rankings/): Men's college basketball rankings and poll updates.
- [Women's College Basketball Rankings](https://www.cbssports.com/womens-college-basketball/rankings/): Women's college basketball rankings and poll coverage.
- [NFL Draft](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/draft/): NFL Draft news, prospect rankings, mock drafts, and team needs.
- [NBA Draft](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/draft/): NBA Draft coverage with prospect analysis and mock drafts.

## Fantasy Sports

- [Fantasy Basketball](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/): Fantasy basketball projections, rankings, and roster advice.
- [Fantasy Hockey](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/hockey/): Fantasy hockey rankings, pickups, and player updates.

- [Fantasy Football Draft Prep](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/football/draft/): Draft-focused fantasy football rankings, sleepers, and strategy.
- [Fantasy Baseball Draft Prep](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/baseball/draft-prep/): Draft prep tools, rankings, and sleepers for fantasy baseball.

- [College Football Picks](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/picks/): College football picks and betting analysis for weekly games.
- [NBA Picks](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/picks/): NBA picks, predictions, and betting insights for daily matchups.
- [MLB Picks](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/picks/): MLB picks and projections for daily baseball games.
- [NCAA Tournament Bracket Game](https://picks.cbssports.com/college-basketball/ncaa-tournament/bracket): Interactive March Madness bracket game with pool and pick features.
- [College Basketball Picks](https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/picks/): College basketball picks, predictions, and tournament betting coverage.
